run_sawyer_grasp_simulation: run the SawyerPickAndPlaceEnvYZ environment to simulate a robot arm grasping an object
run_env_reset_and_step: run env.reset then env.step with a gripper close action for 20 timesteps
run_set_to_goal: run env.set_to_goal with a generated state_desired_goal to position the object in hand
run_generate_uncorrected_env_goals: run env.generate_uncorrected_env_goals to sample presampled goal states for the environment
run_env_render: run env.render inside a step loop to visualize the Sawyer robot grasping simulation
